messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Can I talk to someone at the front desk?
I can't transfer the call, but I can take a message for our staff to call you back. May I ask what you're calling about?
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say it again, please?
I have something I want to talk about.
Of course. Could you please tell me what it's about?
Thank you, Taro Yamada. May I have a phone number where our staff can reach you?
Let me confirm. Your name is Taro Yamada, and your phone number is zero nine zero, one two three four, five six seven eight. Is that correct?
Thank you. I’ll pass your information to our staff, and they will contact you within one business day. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
